content: Goday, “Moo7abe asay zaari zaari oothida nagaraa gisho, taani enta seeronna aggike. Enti Edoome kawa meqethay bido gidana gakanaw xuuggidosona.
Hessa gisho, taani Moo7abe biittan tama yeddana; he tamay Qiriyoota katamaa miixata maana. Olanchota waasuwan, moyze punuwaninne ola girsan Moo7abe asay wurana.
Taani Moo7abe haareysanne iya moorinnata ubbaa dhaysana” yaagees.
Goday, “Yihuda asay zaari zaari oothida nagaraa gisho, taani enta seeronna aggike. Enti Godaa higgiya ixidosona; iya kiitaa naagibookona. Enta aawati kaallida wordo xoossati entana balethidosona.
Hessa gisho, taani Yihuda bolla tama yeddana; he tamay Yerusalaame miixata maana” yaagees.
Goday, “Isra7eele asay zaari zaari oothida nagaraa gisho, taani enta seeronna aggike. Enti xilluwa miishes, manquwa caammas bayzoosona.
Manqota biitta baanan yeggidi, enta huuphiya yedhoosona; un7etidaysata pirda diggoosona. Aawaranne na7aara issi maccasi laggethidi ta geeshsha sunthaa tunisoosona.
Enti asape acos oykida ma7uwa yarshiya bessatan ubbaa matan hiixidi, zin7oosona; qassi asape acos ekida woyne ushsha banta xoossata keethan uyoosona.
“Gidoshin, hinte gisho gada zigada aduqida, wolada minnida Amoore asata hinte sinthafe dhaysiday tana. Taani entaw bolla ayfiya, garsa xaphuwa ubbaa dhaysas.
Taani hintena Gibxe biittafe kessada, bazzon oytamu laythi kaalethas; Amooreta biitta hintew laata oothada immas.
Hinte adde nayta giddofe nabeta, hinte na7atethata giddofe Naaziraweta denthas. Isra7eele asaw, hessi tuma gidennee? Taani Goday hessa odas.
Shin hinte Naaziraweta caaqo menthisidi, woyne ushsha ushshideta; nabeta tinbite odonna mela diggideta.
“Hessa gisho, kathi darsidi caanida gaarey me77eysada taani hintena menthana.
Gooba woxeysi kessi ekenna; minuwas wolqi ixana; olanchoy ba shempuwa ashshena.
Dongen dukeysi eqanaw danda7enna; gooba woxiya olanchoy kessi ekenna; paraaway ba shempuwa ashshena.
He gallas hari attoshin olanchota giddon daro xaala geeteteysati xire kallo baqatana” yaagees Goday.
